rule: This is a total launch cap, not monthly authorization. Any charge taking cumulative launch spending above $50 requires explicit user approval. The $19 Shopify registration invoice is paid. Staging compute is stopped between attended tests; no new hosting subscription was purchased.

staging.notes: Metered usage before credits, not an invoice or confirmed card charge. Usage may lag; bucket charges are not itemized. Compute remains stopped after assigning the separate development app credentials and clearing the former public app billing settings. Volume and encrypted recovery bucket remain retained and metered. This transition did not open a database. recoveryBucketBytes remains the older measurement at recoveryBucketBytesCheckedAt. Reconcile both projects against the $50 total launch cap.

production.notes: Separate production preparation only. The public Shopify app credentials and billing settings are assigned, but no deploy source, public domain, application runtime or merchant database has been activated. Storage and encrypted operator/control records remain metered while compute is stopped. No new subscription or confirmed launch charge; the $50 total cap still applies. See shopify-environment-verification.json.
